# Step 3: Update the note content to mark the item as done
username='ja-solomon@gmail.com'
password='cn$Fr]h'
access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username=username,password=password)['access_token']
note_id=251
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
content=note['content']
old_line='[ ] Witnessing a total solar eclipse'
new_line='[x] Witnessing a total solar eclipse'
print('contains_old', old_line in content)
print('contains_new', new_line in content)
new_content=content.replace(old_line,new_line,1)
print('replaced', content!=new_content)
# Apply update
res=apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token, content=new_content)
print('update_res', res)
# Verify
note2=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
print('verify_line_done', new_line in note2['content'])
print('verify_line_not_done', old_line in note2['content'])
